reference.title: Parameters sub-tab
reference.shortdesc: In the Parameters sub-tab, you can plot raw vibration data in X and Z axes

section.p: In the Parameters sub-tab, you can plot raw vibration data in X and Z axes (acceleration [m/s2], and magnetic field) in two different domains.
The SMS device collects a sample of 2.5 seconds of data every 40 minutes. The horizontal axis shows these 2.5 seconds.
